thread:
Matt: Heads-up, scheduling deploy to prod tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 PT. Need explicit rollback owners and a short validation plan. Who can own what?

Jess: I'll own smoke tests and the rollback verification steps. Will add concrete commands to runbook.

Omar: On-call 09:00-11:00 PT. Confirm: no DB migrations in this release?

Matt: Correct, no DB changes. Main rollback path: disable new routing ff + helm rollback. Also fallback LB routing to previous canary.

Sophie: Draft rollback sequence below, I'll put this in the runbook:
1) Cut canary traffic at LB
2) Flip feature flag `routing_v2` -> OFF
3) Helm rollback to previous revision: `helm rollback inference-release 2 --namespace redwood`
4) Ensure KV cache warming disabled and clear short-lived cache entries
5) Monitor key metrics (errors, p50 latency) for 15m

Sophie: Runbook snippet:
```
# check rollout status
kubectl -n redwood rollout status deploy/inference-svc
# rollback
helm rollback inference-release 2 --namespace redwood
# adjust svc if needed
kubectl -n redwood patch svc inference-svc -p '{"spec": {"externalTrafficPolicy":"Cluster"}}'
```

Jess: Smoke checklist I'll run at T+5m after deploy:
- /healthz = 200
- /metrics available
- sample generation latency p50 < 150ms
- no 5xxs on /v1/generate for 5m
- embeddings pipeline sample batch (Alex will assist)
I'll post GO/NO-GO at T-10m and results after checks.

Chris: Infra will coordinate LB cut. If rollback is required, Sophie to run helm rollback? Confirmed?

Sophie: Yep I will execute helm rollback. Omar will coordinate oncall actions and alerts.

deploy-bot: Release rel-20260318-09 created. Window: 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z ±30m. Reminder T-15m.

Matt: Decision flow: at T-10m Jess publishes GO/NO-GO. NO-GO -> immediate rollback checklist and postmortem. GO -> proceed and monitor.

Alex: I'll stand by to run embeddings verification and small batch queries if pinged.

Matt: Please add a short availability line before EOD so we know who is reachable during the window.

Omar: available 09:00-11:30 PT
